name: Cloud chamber / a window into elsewhere
art: The original environment is site/assets/motion/cloud-chamber.webp. It was authored with an empty opening for the live optical centre. Reuse compatible artwork or create an equally detailed original environment; keep background crop and live-object coordinates coupled.

properties.label: Monumental arch with anchored focal object
properties.text: Raise a monumental limestone and bronze arch above a reflective pool and walkway, with a live optical sphere anchored inside its opening. Reserve quiet sky for large dark architectural type on wide screens and use a separately composed portrait image region to protect the words.

properties.label: Layered architectural landscape
properties.text: Author a connected environment of porous stone, warm bronze edges, cool sky, atmospheric distance, a scale-giving walkway and water that reflects the mass above it.

properties.label: Clear sphere with fine metallic rings
properties.text: Anchor one thick clear glass sphere with very fine metallic rings inside the architectural opening, preserving a sharp spherical boundary and internal reflected structure.

properties.label: Environment-matched optical glass
properties.text: Make the sphere's reflection and lighting agree with the pictured landscape. Avoid an unrelated rectangular studio reflection that makes the live object feel pasted in.

properties.label: Motion held inside the optical centre
properties.text: Clear, Warm and Cool vary the optical centre. Slow ring movement and subtle pointer response reveal it while architecture and copy remain still.

properties.label: Raster environment with live optics
properties.text: The scene combines original raster environment art with live Three.js optics; it is not a freely traversable 3D world.

properties.label: Breakpoint optical registration
properties.text: At wide and portrait sizes, keep the sphere within the opening. Check glass edge, scene reflection, grounding, text contrast and all fallback states while preserving the walkway and layered environment detail.
